intro: In Westfall, Amber Kearnen watches the Defias Brotherhood for SI:7. From a hidden vantage point, she tracks their unlawful activity for Master Mathias Shaw.

p: Amber Kearnen scouts for SI:7 in Westfall, far from the halls of Stormwind Keep. She watches an abandoned tower the Defias Brotherhood has taken over. Master Mathias Shaw leads her work directly. Kearnen briefs covert operatives sent to stop Defias threats and gather intelligence across the contested countryside.
